name: A Student of Nature
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
narrative.objectives: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
narrative.offerRewardText: The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we druids are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the feather, and the branch.Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
